pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregularly polygonal geometries with high-frequency angular edges on the mid-flank. Pixel area of individual patches is significantly greater than the surrounding light-colored regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned pathways form a continuous negative-space lattice. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-junctions), with consistent pixel thickness across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette with a dense, brush-like texture against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized clusters of light-toned textural disruptions and de-pigmentation are visible on the upper shoulder and neck region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, irregular whitish spots on the lateral neck and shoulder indicate localized skin disruptions or parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (oxpecker) is visible perched on the dorsal ridge near the rump, creating a localized silhouette protrusion.
